title: Collatz frontier verification

base.description: Author-reported operational bound of the distributed Collatz verification project; assumed by CEML, not replicated.

claim: Every integer in the covered interval reaches 1, conditional on the author-reported base. This is a finite, conditional computational result: not a proof of the Collatz conjecture, not a reproduction of the base, and not a claim of a world first or of global frontier extension.
